name: CONSTSTR
runtime_effect: Constant string is materialized by the host linker; runtime instruction is inert.

name: CONSTDBL
runtime_effect: Constant decimal is materialized by the host linker; runtime instruction is inert.

name: CONSTINT
runtime_effect: Constant signed 32-bit integer is materialized by the host linker; runtime instruction is inert.

name: LOAD
runtime_effect: Copy the current variable value into the instruction result slot.

name: SAVE
record_operands: a=destination variable slot, b=source expression slot
runtime_effect: Copy the expression value into the variable slot.

name: INC
runtime_effect: Increment integer or decimal in place; other types are unchanged in the historical VM.

name: DEC
runtime_effect: Decrement integer or decimal in place; other types are unchanged in the historical VM.

name: FIELD
runtime_effect: Present in the numeric ABI but absent from historical compile and runtime switches. Trap deterministically.

name: CALL
record_operands: a=target ID, b=result slot, c=callsite metadata ID
runtime_effect: Invoke script/import/native target using the callsite argument-slot list.

name: POS
runtime_effect: Unary plus. Historical implementation is intentionally inert.

name: NEG
runtime_effect: Negate integer or decimal in place. Verify the exact Build 4086 decimal quirk with an oracle.

name: NOT
runtime_effect: Replace operand with VT_INTEGER 0 or 1 using VM truthiness.

name: MUL
runtime_effect: Numeric multiplication; decimal result if either operand is decimal.

name: DIV
runtime_effect: Numeric division; integer division truncates toward zero. Divide-by-zero becomes EMPTY in historical code.

name: MOD
runtime_effect: Integer-converted remainder. Historical zero divisor is unsafe; SA-1 VM must fault deterministically.

name: ERR
runtime_effect: Set VM fault status immediately.

name: ADD
runtime_effect: Numeric addition, or string concatenation when either operand is a string.

name: SUB
runtime_effect: Numeric subtraction; decimal result if either operand is decimal.

name: SHL
runtime_effect: Convert operands to 32-bit integer; unsigned logical left shift.

name: SHR
runtime_effect: Convert operands to 32-bit integer; unsigned logical right shift.

name: JUMP
runtime_effect: Set IP to target.

name: PJUMP
runtime_effect: Same runtime effect as JUMP after host linking. The old compile pass discarded one compile-stack item.

name: GE
runtime_effect: Store VT_INTEGER boolean for left >= right.

name: LE
runtime_effect: Store VT_INTEGER boolean for left <= right.

name: LT
runtime_effect: Store VT_INTEGER boolean for left < right.

name: GT
runtime_effect: Store VT_INTEGER boolean for left > right.

name: EQ
runtime_effect: Store VT_INTEGER boolean for equality.

name: NE
runtime_effect: Store VT_INTEGER truth value for inequality. Verify historical string-result normalization.

name: OR
runtime_effect: Store VT_INTEGER 0/1 from truth(left) OR truth(right). Both operands have already been evaluated.

name: AND
runtime_effect: Store VT_INTEGER 0/1 from truth(left) AND truth(right). Both operands have already been evaluated.

name: BIT_OR
runtime_effect: Integer-convert operands and store signed 32-bit bitwise OR.

name: XOR
runtime_effect: Integer-convert operands and store signed 32-bit XOR.

name: BIT_AND
runtime_effect: Integer-convert operands and store signed 32-bit bitwise AND.

name: NOOP
runtime_effect: No runtime effect.

name: PUSH
runtime_effect: Compile-time symbol-scope marker; no runtime effect after linking.

name: POP
runtime_effect: Compile-time symbol-scope marker; no runtime effect after linking.

name: Branch_FALSE
runtime_effect: Branch when condition is false by VM truthiness.

name: Branch_TRUE
runtime_effect: Branch when condition is true by VM truthiness.

name: Branch_EQUAL
runtime_effect: Branch when equality comparison is true.

name: DATA
runtime_effect: Compile-time symbol declaration; no runtime effect after linking.

name: PARAM
runtime_effect: Copy the next argument from the active call frame; clear to EMPTY when absent.

name: IMMEDIATE
runtime_effect: Marks immediate-code range for the host linker; no ordinary runtime effect.

name: DEFERRED
runtime_effect: Ends immediate-code range for the host linker; no ordinary runtime effect.

name: RET
runtime_effect: Complete current call, copy any staged return value, and resume caller or finish the root invocation.

name: CHECKARG
runtime_effect: Historical runtime check is disabled. Exporter may validate statically.

name: CLEAN
runtime_effect: Compile-stack cleanup marker; no runtime effect after linking.

name: JUMPR
record_operands: a=function epilogue target, b=return-value source slot
runtime_effect: Stage return source in current frame, then jump to the function epilogue.

name: FUNCDECL
runtime_effect: Function declaration marker; no runtime effect after linking.
